state.game: Step Tetris, assisted planning. Engine enumerates ALL reachable placements and predicts their outcomes. You select; engine executes the selected legal path with step gravity, not hard drop.

move.instructions: Choose the best outcome to maximize long-term line-clear score. Avoid game_over. Holes are trapped empty cells: fewer is strongly better. Prefer clearing rows, low height_sum and low roughness. Compare the numeric outcomes carefully. The order is NOT a ranking. Return the label of the best outcome.

function.name: place_piece
function.description: Select one legal candidate placement. The caller executes its path under the supplied game rules. Call exactly once.

placement_id.description: ID of the chosen legal placement
